title: GAPFarm audit package manifest (IF-66)
description: manifest.json inside every GAP audit package (PDF + XLSX + manifest). Produced by trg_export_hash from farm.export_package; verify_hash = sha256(canonical manifest). An auditor recomputes it with GET /export/gap/{id}/verify or offline (OPS-12 section 10). The records array lists the CURRENT version of every record in the period with its chain hash; chain_heads carries each zone's chain head (seq + hash). NFR-04, FR-13, AC-05.
$comment: Loader / verifier rules beyond the schema: record_count == len(records); every record.zone is a key of chain_heads; the package's verify_hash equals sha256 of the manifest serialised with PostgreSQL jsonb canonical text (keys ordered by length then bytes, ', ' and ': ' separators).
